scissors.definition: A hand tool with two hinged blades used to cut food or packaging.

funnel.definition: A tool with a wide top and narrow spout for pouring liquid into a small opening.

teaspoon.definition: A small spoon, or a cooking measure commonly equal to 5 milliliters.

tablespoon.definition: A larger spoon, or a cooking measure commonly equal to 15 milliliters.

juicer.definition: A device that extracts juice from fruit or vegetables.

boil.definition: To cook food in liquid that is bubbling at its boiling point.

simmer.definition: To cook food gently in liquid kept just below a full boil.

stew.definition: To cook food slowly in liquid.

grill.definition: To cook food over direct heat, often on a metal grid.

toast.definition: To heat bread or other food until its surface becomes brown and crisp.

smoke.definition: To expose food to smoke to add flavor or help preserve it.

dehydrate.definition: To dry food by removing much of its moisture.

rotisserie.definition: A method of roasting food on a rotating spit.

sear.definition: To brown the surface of food quickly with strong heat.

chop.definition: To cut food into pieces with a knife.

dice.definition: To cut food into small cubes.

mince.definition: To cut food into very small pieces.

blend.definition: To mix ingredients until they are combined, often using a blender.

knead.definition: To press, stretch, and fold dough to develop its texture.

beat.definition: To mix ingredients vigorously with a whisk, spoon, or mixer.

cream.definition: To beat fat and sugar together until the mixture becomes light and smooth.
cream.arabicTranslation: يخفق الدهن والسكر حتى يصبحا كريميين

cardamom.definition: An aromatic spice made from the seeds or pods of the cardamom plant.

basil.definition: An aromatic herb with leaves used to flavor food.

thyme.definition: An herb with small aromatic leaves used in cooking.

parsley.definition: An herb with green leaves used to flavor or garnish food.

cilantro.definition: The fresh leaves of the coriander plant, used as an herb.

mint.definition: An aromatic herb with leaves used to flavor food and drinks.

sage.definition: An herb with aromatic gray-green leaves used as a seasoning.

mayonnaise.definition: A thick sauce traditionally made from oil, egg yolk, and vinegar or lemon juice.

worcestershire.definition: A dark savory sauce used to season food.

pesto.definition: A sauce traditionally made with basil, oil, nuts, garlic, and cheese.

vegetable-oil.definition: Oil extracted from plants and commonly used for cooking.

jelly.definition: A clear sweet fruit preserve made from juice, sugar, and a gelling substance.

agave.definition: A sweet syrup made from the agave plant and used as a sweetener.
